0022600160.text: The Hawks (3-4, 2nd in the Southeast and 7th in the East) visit the Pacers (2-4, 3rd in the Central and 12th in the East) for Atlanta's eighth game of the season, with Atlanta on a one-game losing streak and Indiana on a three-game skid. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Jalen Johnson (ankle) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), Obi Toppin (back soreness), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain). The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, the Hawks won 2-1 in the 2025-26 season series, and their last meeting was a 129-124 Atlanta loss in Indianapolis on January 31.
